caption: The drawing depicts a painted wooden rocking horse viewed from the side, facing left. The rocking horse is predominantly grayish blue in color, with patches of worn and chipped paint exposing the brown wood underneath, especially on the body and the curved rocker. The head of the horse displays an open mouth with visible teeth and a red tongue, as well as a white-rimmed eye with a black pupil. There is a small brown vertical handle or support placed behind the horse's neck, and the body of the horse is hollowed out to form a rectangular seat area. The back of the horse features a raised, sculpted tail. The overall composition is centered inside a single outlined rectangular frame set against a light beige or off-white background. The rocking horse fills the majority of the frame, with the rockers extending horizontally and curving upward at both ends.
title: Toy Rocking Horse
